source_bundle.mjcf_upstream: Gymnasium Robotics v1.4.2 (commit 42eae53b2b27321d29090c219ce2f675c596de77) Shadow Hand, flattened by the bundle to Isaac Lab's repose-cube configuration (Profile B: four J1/J0 coupling tendons)

licenses.LICENSE.md: the bundle's model_parity_audit/.../envs/assets/LICENSE.md, verbatim: the Shadow Hand model's attribution and its Apache License 2.0 terms; the bundle's THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md says it must stay with the STL assets
licenses.gymnasium-license.txt: the bundle's docs/licenses/dependencies/gymnasium-license.txt, verbatim: Gymnasium Robotics' MIT licence, which the MJCF derives from
licenses.LICENSE-isaaclab.txt: the bundle's root LICENSE, verbatim: BSD-3-Clause, Isaac Lab's, for the repose-cube configuration the bundle ported

meshes.pre_scaling: The source's <mesh scale="0.001 0.001 0.001">, which crates/es-assets/src/mjcf/elements.rs refuses by name, baked into the vertex data: binary STL, 80-byte header and triangle count kept, each 50-byte facet's nine vertex floats replaced by float32(float64(v) * 0.001) (one rounding), the facet normal kept (a uniform scale does not change it), the attribute count written as 0. Sizes are unchanged.

derivation: Kept unchanged: every body, inertial, joint (name, axis, range, armature, damping), geom (type, size, pose, friction, condim, contype, conaffinity, mass), the <option> (timestep 1/120 s, implicitfast, 20 iterations), the four coupling tendons' joints, coefficients, limits and damping, the 17 <contact><pair>s, every body's gravcomp, the 24 jointpos sensors and the <default> classes' dynamics attributes.
Header comment and model name replaced (`shadow_hand_repose`); XML comments added where something was added.
<compiler>: meshdir is `meshes/` (the vendored copies); texturedir dropped (no texture file is referenced any more).

Dropped as not represented by SceneDesc and not dynamics: <size> (njmax, nconmax, nstack, nuser_*: memory sizing and user-data widths), <custom> (the bundle's metadata texts and the joint velocity limit 100.00003814697266 rad/s, which the source's own comment says has no native MJCF meaning), <visual>, <light name="light0">, every `user` attribute (joints and actuators), `group` on sites and geoms, the <default> class `robot0:asset_class`'s joint `margin="0"` (MuJoCo's default) and site `rgba`, `content_type` on meshes.
Dropped with their only users: the five <touch> sensors, the five `robot0:Tch_*` sites they read and the `robot0:D_Touch` default class.

<asset>: the five <texture>s and eight <material>s dropped -- es-render draws a geom's rgba, not its material. Colours moved to rgba: class `robot0:D_Vizual` rgba "0.93 0.93 0.93 1" (MatViz's colour), class `robot0:DC_Hand` rgba "0.4 0.5 0.6 0" (MatColl's colour at alpha 0), and the seven collision geoms' own translucent rgba overrides (0.1 / 0.2 / 0.7, which only served MuJoCo's viewer) removed so the class's alpha 0 applies. The floor `floor0` keeps floor_mat's colour "0.2 0.2 0.2 0": alpha 0, as in the source. Alpha 0 is not drawn by es-render (crates/es-render/src/scene.rs, packet H1).
<mesh scale="0.001 0.001 0.001"> removed from the ten meshes whose STLs are pre-scaled (see `meshes`).

The twenty <general dyntype=none gaintype=fixed gainprm="kp" biastype="affine" biasprm="0 -kp -kv"> servos written as <position kp="kp" kv="kv">, which MuJoCo compiles to exactly those parameters (wrist: kp 5, kv 0.5; the rest: kp 1, kv 0.10000000149011612); ctrlrange, forcerange and class kept, and the class's <general ctrllimited forcelimited> default written as <position ...>.
The four tendons' `springlength="0"` dropped: MuJoCo's default is the length at qpos0, which is 0 for these couplings (every joint at 0), and their stiffness is 0.
Single-value site sizes (`object:center`, `target:center`, size 0.01) written as three values, which is what MuJoCo expands them to; their rgba (alpha 0) dropped.

Four orientations written as the unit vectors SceneDesc stores, so that `parse -> SceneDesc -> scene_to_mjcf` writes them back bit for bit and MuJoCo compiles the emitted file exactly as it compiles this one: the hand mount's quat (9.381843730734243e-7 9.381873730746175e-7 -0.7071082811849306 0.7071052811837377, source 9.38184e-07 9.38187e-07 -0.707108 0.707105), LFJ4's axis (0.5709770263548727 0 0.8209660378937408, source 0.570977 0 0.820966), thbase's quat (0.9239559191829653 0 0.3824989665433906 0, source 0.923956 0 0.382499 0) and C_wrist's quat (0.7071067811865476 0.7071067811865476 0 0, source 0.707107 0.707107 0 0). The first two are exactly what MuJoCo makes of the source text; for the last two, es_math::Quat::normalize and MuJoCo's normalization differ in the last bit and no value is a fixed point of both.

The held cube `object`: its box keeps collision, mass 0.216 and condim 4 and gets rgba alpha 0; `object_hidden` (the textured inner cube, mass 0, no collision) dropped; six visual-only face slabs added, each a box 1 mm thick covering one face from the inside (contype 0, conaffinity 0, mass 0): +x red, -x cyan, +y green, -y magenta, +z blue, -z yellow. MuJoCo's compiled mass and inertia of the body are unchanged (0.216 kg, diag 1.296e-4).

The goal cube `target`: moved from (1, 0.87, 0.2) -- where it overlapped the held cube -- to (1.12, 0.87, 0.2), beside the little finger, where all three cameras see it (the Task IR's reset sets its pose); its box gets alpha 0 and the same six slabs; gravcomp 1, no collision, mass 0.216 as in the source.
Added `ceiling_light`: a visual-only world box (half extents 0.6 0.6 0.005 at (1, 0.95, 0.9), rgba 1) whose `_light` suffix makes it the path tracer's emitter.

Added three world-fixed cameras at fovy 45 (MJCF: look down -Z, +Y up): `top` at (1.04, 0.88, 0.56) looking straight down, image up +Y (towards the wrist); `front` at (1.04, 0.52, 0.36) aimed at (1.04, 0.87, 0.17), in front of the fingertips (xyaxes "1 0 0 0 0.4771 0.8789"); `side` at (0.68, 0.72, 0.36) aimed at (1.04, 0.88, 0.17), from the thumb side and in front (xyaxes "0.4061 -0.9138 0 0.397 0.1764 0.9007"). Chosen by rendering them (crates/es-render/tests/shadow_hand.rs, ES_RENDER_DUMP).
measured: MuJoCo 3.13.0 compiles the source file and this one to the same model in everything that reaches the dynamics except: thbase's body_quat and C_wrist's geom_quat (1 ulp, 1.1e-16), and what mj_setConst derives from them (dof_invweight0, body_invweight0, actuator_acc0, dof_M0: <= 2e-10 relative); the target's body_pos and qpos0 (moved); pair_geom1/2 (indices shift by one: ceiling_light is a world geom); dof_length (the slabs and pre-scaled meshes change body extents; no effect on the trajectory, below).

With the source's four orientation strings and target position put back, this file and the source give bit-identical qpos (MuJoCo 3.13.0, 240 ticks from qpos0: 120 with every servo at 0 clamped to its range, then 120 at 10 / 20 / 30 / 40% of its range): the servo respelling, the removals, the slabs and the pre-scaled meshes change nothing. As committed, the one-ulp orientations grow through contact: after those 240 ticks the hand and held cube differ from the source by 1.7e-10 / 4.0e-10 / 2.9e-7 / 1.1e-5. With every servo held at 0, both files run 10 s without a MuJoCo instability warning.

crates/es-physics-backend/tests/shadow_hand.rs: MuJoCoCpuBackend (parse -> SceneDesc -> emitted MJCF) and MuJoCo loading this file directly agree bit for bit (max |dqpos| 0.0) over 240 ticks, 120 at the servos' zero and 120 at 40% of their ranges, up to 13 contacts including fingertip pairs.
crates/es-render/tests/shadow_hand.rs: at 96x96 the held cube covers 462 / 467 / 524 pixels and the goal cube 500 / 508 / 235 in top / front / side (CPU Rs; the Pt segmentation agrees).
